new_task_1.title: Make groupby work correctly with IndexVariable inputs and MultiIndex level labels
new_task_1.description: The upgrade fixes grouping behavior so xarray can reliably group data using `IndexVariable` objects and coordinate labels derived from MultiIndex levels, producing the expected grouped keys and reductions instead of mishandling index conversion.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that `groupby()` correctly resolves grouping labels when the grouper is provided as an `IndexVariable` or when grouping by a named level of a MultiIndex-backed coordinate.

expectation.grounded: Group resolution should normalize variable-based groupers through a `DataArray` path and cache group labels using the grouper's own `to_index()` implementation rather than a generic index cast. As a result, `DataArray.groupby(...)` and related grouped operations should accept `IndexVariable` inputs representing coordinate labels, and grouping by a MultiIndex level name should expose the correct label-to-position mapping in `.groups` and downstream reductions.
expectation.conceptual: Users should be able to group data by explicit coordinate/index objects or by a level inside a MultiIndex without needing to convert those labels manually. Group keys should preserve the intended label values and positional membership for grouped computations.

constraints.grounded: The fix should not change ordinary groupby behavior for existing `DataArray` and coordinate-name groupers. Grouper length must still match the target dimension length, and invalid groupers should continue to fail through the existing validation path rather than being silently reshaped.
constraints.conceptual: The update should improve compatibility for index-backed grouping inputs without altering the semantics of standard groupby operations or weakening shape validation.

behavior: Grouping with an `IndexVariable` built from coordinate values should produce the same grouped result as grouping with equivalent coordinate labels supplied through standard xarray objects.
Grouped reductions such as `sum()` should aggregate values under the correct label buckets when the grouper is an `IndexVariable`.
When grouping by a named level of a MultiIndex coordinate, the resulting `.groups` mapping should use the level labels as keys and list the correct source positions for each group.
Group label resolution should respect specialized index conversion logic supplied by the grouper instead of relying on a generic cast.
acceptance_criteria: When a caller passes an `IndexVariable` containing labels aligned to a dimension into `groupby()`, grouped reductions should succeed and return the expected values for each label.
When the same grouping labels are represented through a regular xarray coordinate or an `IndexVariable`, the grouped result should be equivalent.
When a `DataArray` uses a MultiIndex coordinate and the caller groups by one level name, the `.groups` property should report the correct label-to-index-position mapping for that level.
When the supplied grouper length does not match the grouped dimension length, `groupby()` should still reject the input rather than attempting implicit alignment.
